title: GRSM, Roof Replacements on 5 Bldgs, NC
agency: INTERIOR, DEPARTMENT OF THE.NATIONAL PARK SERVICE.SER NORTH MABO (53000)
description_text: National Park Service (NPS), Great Smoky Mountains National Park, is issuing combined sol/synopsis for Roof Replacements on 5 buildings at Collins Creek picnic area (3 Bldgs) and Deep Creek picnic area (2 Bldgs). Location: Great Smoky Mountains National Park, Collins Creek Picnic Area, and Deep Creek Picnic, North Carolina, Swain County, NC TYPE OF CONTRACT: Firm Fixed Price 100% small business set-aside procurement. The NAICS code is 238260 Roofing Contractors $19M Period of Performance 150 days from NTP SYSTEM FOR AWARD MANAGEMENT (SAM): Federal Acquisition Regulations require that federal contractors register in the System for Award Management (SAM) database at https://www.sam.gov and enter all mandatory information into the system. Award cannot be made until the contractor has registered. Interested Offerors are encouraged to ensure that they are registered in SAM prior to submitting their quote. THESE REGISTRATIONS WILL BE COMPLETED BEFORE TIME OF AWARD. Questions cut-off date: 6/5/2026, 1PM EDT send via-email to Ashley_Warcewicz@ios.doi.gov Site Visit: scheduled for 6/4/2026, 10am EDT meet at Deep creek structures, and then Collins creek structures 12pm EDT. Meet at the Deep Creek Pavilion then walk to the comfort station, then will leave area to drive to Collins creek Request for proposals closes 6/17/2026 at 5pm EDT send via-email all proposals to Ashley_Warcewicz@ios.doi.gov The contracting office will not provide hardcopies or email copies of solicitation. No Phone calls, please.
